title: Chat approval refuses when a hook could answer
assertion: Approvals in chat are refused, and nothing changes, while any Elicitation or ElicitationResult hook SeamSpec can see could match its server; this is checked before a dialog is shown and again before an answer is acted on.

origin.text: Owner, 2026-10-08: "propose the three rules for the dialog test" (the rules ADR-20261006-c300 lists for approvals in chat).
